hooks.name: block-env-read
hooks.command: python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': 'Blocked: .env is sensitive — use config.py or ask user to provide the value'}}))"
hooks.description: Block reading .env via hooks (stronger than permissions.json ask)

hooks.name: lint-on-write
hooks.description: Post-write Python compile check — appends lint error to tool result for LLM to fix
